x-card.description: Collections and documents of Typesense and Typesense Cloud: typo-tolerant search with filters, facets and sorting. Document writes and deletes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Typesense's address with https:// (and its port, 8108 for a server of your own), optionally with a path prefix. Plain http:// only to this computer.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer a key with documents:search, documents:get and collections:get only, unless agents should write.

indexes.title: Collections
indexes.description: The collections agents may use; * matches any characters, such as products_*. Empty: every collection the credentials see.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
